name: Tokico Mechanical Drum Flow Meter
description: Heavy industrial fuel/oil flow meter (TOKICO brand). Features a prominent rectangular odometer-style roller digit counter indicating total accumulated Liters/m3 plus an auxiliary fractional needle dial.
shape: Heavy cast-iron casing with rectangular roller drum window
scale_info: 5 to 7 mechanical roller digits (e.g. 130477.9 or 130478.2), unit Liters (L) or m3
indicator_type: Odometer-style mechanical drum wheels (white on black + red decimal) & fractional needle
prompt:
You are inspecting a TOKICO MECHANICAL ROLLER DRUM FLOW METER.
ODOMETER DRUM READING PROTOCOL:
1. LOCATE ROLLER COUNTER WINDOW:
   - Identify the rectangular counter window showing odometer-style mechanical roller digit wheels.
   - Face plate often displays 'TOKICO' or 'OIL METER'.
2. READ DIGIT WHEELS SEQUENTIALLY (LEFT TO RIGHT):
   - Read consecutive whole digits (white digits on black background).
   - The rightmost roller drum (or red-colored wheel) represents tenths of a Liter (0.1 L).
   - If a roller drum is mid-transition, reference the auxiliary sub-dial or determine incoming digit.
   - Combine into complete float reading (e.g. '130477.9' or '130478.2').
3. AUXILIARY FRACTIONAL DIAL:
   - An auxiliary circular sub-dial (0.0 - 1.0 L in 0.05 increments) confirms fine fractional flow.
4. OUTPUT FORMAT (RAW JSON ONLY):
{
  "gauges": [{
    "gauge_index": 1,
    "gauge_type": "flowmeter",
    "bbox": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax],
    "reading": {"value": <float e.g. 130477.9>, "unit": "L", "confidence": 0.98},
    "display_type": "roller_counter",
    "digits_text": "<digit string e.g. 130477.9>"
  }]
}
